## Cargo Standard Operating Procedure This document is kept intentionally very lean and mostly pertains to Salvage and the Salvage Lead.
# Part one: Succession, and acting. In the event of a lack of a Quartermaster, succession is generally as follows: (Keep in mind that this is optional and can be declined by individual persons) Quartermaster \> Salvage Lead \> Salvage Specialist \> Cargo Technician \> Mail Technician \> Mining Specialist
# Part two: Salvage Due to Salvage being mindshielded, they are permitted to maintain and store contraband on the Expeditioneer for their role. This contraband should be kept off-station outside of Red Alert or higher, and infractions will require the problematic weapons be issued expedition firing pins, or confiscated on repeat offenses.
